exchangeRates.convention: Units of each currency per 1 USD. EUR, GBP, AUD and INR are derived as cross-rates from ECB euro reference rates (1 EUR = 1.1298 USD; 0.85373 GBP; 1.6255 AUD; 108.8320 INR). PKR from State Bank of Pakistan M2M revaluation rate. Convert A to B: amount_A / rate_A * rate_B.
